exposure: patient fear of contracting COVID-19 in hospital
Births during the peak of the first COVID-19 pandemic in 2020
Births during the corresponding periods in 2017-2019
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a decrease in prenatal emergency labor ward admissions and an increase in stillbirth rate, while other obstetric outcomes remained similar.
mod_finding: Rates of mode of delivery, including emergency cesarean deliveries, were similar between patients who gave birth during the COVID-19 pandemic and those who gave birth pre-pandemic.
